target.interpretation: Illustrative design target for demonstrating the pipeline; not a serviceability requirement, engineering design limit, safety criterion or claim of optimality.

supported_range.evidence: cases/bridge/BridgeCase.tsx: Primary section scale Range; cases/bridge/model.mjs: createModel section mapping
supported_range.interpretation: Conservatively retain the existing application control range. The generator accepts unbounded arithmetic inputs but does not establish support outside this range. 1.50 is supported; 1.75 is not.

acceptance.reference: Unchanged solver-exported initial/load residual tolerances and validation/physics/protocol.json global force/moment relative thresholds. Existing screening indicators are reported, not treated as safety certification or added stop criteria.

stopping.interpretation: Fixed controller precedence; order is documented here and enforced in code. Bridge reports retain their historical reason names.

provenance.definition: User-specified fixed Version 2 policy; supported range inspected in unchanged Version 1 application.
